# Runtime-fetched official Skills

`make competition-up` downloads the four files required for Alibaba Cloud's
official `alibabacloud-bailian-image-creator` image-understanding path from the
exact commit recorded in `../OFFICIAL_SKILLS.lock`. Every file is SHA-256
verified before it is made available to the backend image.

Fetched upstream files are intentionally not committed or relicensed here.
Their repository history and attribution remain with Alibaba Cloud.
